obligations.note: The change sets mortgage.privileged_idle_minutes to 20, exceeding the obligation's hard bound of ≤ 15. Policy.java and policy-params.json both show 20, directly violating the 15-minute maximum stated in the obligation catalog.

The deviation from SES-1 has no covering exception. The only SES-1 exception (EXC-0141) is scoped to payments.session, not mortgage, and is expired (2026-09-16 < review time 2026-10-16). No valid exception exists to make the deviation acceptable.

Ticket CHG-24534 is type 'standard', status 'approved' by change_manager erik.brandt, and its components (mortgage.controls-data, mortgage.policy, mortgage.tests) cover all three files the change touches.

A code_review approval from wen.li@fernbrook.example (Wen Li, change_approver role, baseline-mortgage app) is present; Wen Li is a different person from the author Priya Raman, so independence is satisfied.
Both approvals name commit 8eacf77be227238d733eec0391cbe4e40df9d1cf, which is the sole and head commit of the change. No later commits exist, so the approval covers exactly what is merged.

CI run on the final commit (ea3491…) shows 124 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped, including controls.SessionControlTest#privilegedIdleTimeoutWithinPolicy. The full suite passed on the head commit.

The change touches controls/mortgage/policy-params.json (a protected path). A control_owner approval from rachel.stein@fernbrook.example (controls-office team, outside the author's lending-eng team) is on the head commit, satisfying CHG-6.

Ledger entries ACR-0405 and ACR-0406 cover specific symbols (UNDERWRITER_LIMIT, SENIOR_LIMIT, DTI_MAX_PERCENT, LTV_MAX_PERCENT) in Policy.java. The change only modifies PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES; the covered symbols are unchanged in behaviour, so the prior evidence remains valid.

summary: The change raises the privileged idle timeout from 15 to 20 minutes, directly violating obligation SES-1, which mandates a maximum of 15 minutes. No valid exception in the register covers this deviation: the only SES-1 exception (EXC-0141) is scoped to the payments app and has already expired. While the change-management process steps (ticket, independent code review, control-owner approval for the protected path, CI on the final commit, and evidence-lapse check) are all satisfied, the product obligation itself is breached. The change must be rejected until the privileged idle timeout is restored to ≤ 15 minutes or a valid, unexpired exception scoped to mortgage.session is obtained from the CISO office.
